environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of a sandboxed directory where outputMode='file' may write PDFs. Unset: every tool returns base64 only (file output disabled).
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches encrypt/decrypt, sign, timestamp, add_ltv, update_metadata, encrypted builds or file output.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless). Unauthenticated unless PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Never logged.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Per-stream FlateDecode decompression cap in bytes (zip-bomb mitigation; default 104857600 = 100 MiB). Integer >= 1024; an invalid value refuses to start the server.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: http(s) URL of the RFC 3161 timestamp authority used by sign_pdf timestamp=true and timestamp_pdf (PAdES B-T / B-LTA). Unset: those calls fail with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED and no network request is made. Tool arguments can never supply a URL.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the TSA (e.g. 'Basic ...' or 'Bearer ...'). Never logged or echoed.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_AUTH

environmentVariables.description: 'ocsp', 'crl' or 'ocsp,crl': enables online revocation collection for add_ltv mode='online' (PAdES B-LT). Unset: that mode fails with REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED; mode='offline' stays fully offline. Requires PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of OCSP / CRL responder hosts ('host', 'host:port' or '*.suffix'). Mandatory when PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION is set: responder URLs found in certificates are fetched only if the host matches (http(s) only, no credentials, no redirects, internal addresses rejected unless listed verbatim).
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout for TSA / OCSP / CRL calls in milliseconds, 1000-120000 (default 10000).
environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS

server.name: io.github.Nizoka/zipnative-mcp
server.description: ZIP MCP server: create, inspect, verify, extract securely, modify without recompression. 13 tools
server.title: zipnative MCP — ZIP creation, inspection, secure extraction & verification

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the one sandbox directory: zipPath / sourcePath inputs are read from it and outputMode='file' / outputDir outputs are written under it (never overwritten; the real path of every file read and of every parent written must stay inside — a planted symlink or junction is SECURITY_VIOLATION). Unset: every tool works on base64 only (no file I/O beyond the opt-in cache).
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches zipPath / sourcePath inputs, file output, defaultDate='now', parallel, describe_engine or draft_governance_issue.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port (POST /mcp) instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless, legacy fallback). Unauthenticated unless ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace; a weaker value refuses to start). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Compared constant-time, never logged.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntryUncompressedSize and limits.maxTotalUncompressedSize in bytes (default 8589934592 = 8 GiB, the engine default). Integer >= 1024, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start. A per-call value above it is refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntries and scan_zip_forward maxEntries (default 100000, the engine default; the scanner's default budget of 10000 is clamped to it, only an explicit value above it is refused). Integer >= 1, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES

environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for create_zip parallel.workers (default 8; with no explicit workers the engine default max(1, min(cores - 1, 8)) applies, bounded by this ceiling; 0 disables worker threads and keeps compression on the calling thread). Integer >= 0, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.
environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_WORKERS
